text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey began searching for an 
Umamusume to cooperate with. Following her 
lucky color, "black," she found Kitasan 
Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she and Copano Rickey used to 
play at the same park when they were 
little. Satono Diamond joins them, and the 
three push each other to improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Copano Rickey noticed an 
Umamusume leaving Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to see any more Umamusume 
face setbacks... I want to save as many as 
I can with feng shui. With this gentle 
resolve in her heart, Copano Rickey 
pursues true strength.
